text:
# seller.draft.reviewRecent

TL;DR:
- Use seller.draftCollection with updatedAt sorting when you want the seller's latest drafts.
- This is the normal browse entry for continuing seller edit work.
whenToUse: When the seller wants to continue recent draft work.
When you do not know the draft id yet.
recommended: Use usedAtIsNull=true if you only want drafts that were not consumed by publish yet.
avoid: Do not use draftFetch if you do not know which exact draft you want.
exampleInterpretation: The first item is usually the best continuation candidate for seller editing.
usedAt=null means the draft is still available for publish.
